en: O Mother of the Praṇava, O Protectress of the Goal, O Protectress of the Family, O Garlanded with Radiance, O Destroyer of Sin, O Caṇḍikā, O Śrī Gāyatrī, let there be salutation unto you! || 1 ||
O Mother of the Trinity, O you of devoted conduct, O you protected by love, O garlanded with asceticism, O destroyer of suffering, O Caṇḍikā, O Anasūyā— salutations be unto you!

O Caṇḍikā, crusher of the demon Mahiṣāsura, salutations be to you! You abide in existence, you are the support of names, you reside in the primordial sound (nāda), you are garlanded with mantras, and you are the destroyer of all that is inauspicious. || 3 ||
O Sovereign of the entire three worlds, you who pacify all afflictions—
just so must you effect the destruction of our enemies.
O destroyer of all enemies, such as Piśācas, Daityas, and evil sorcerers!
Om, salutations to Caṇḍikā, salutations to Caṇḍikā, salutations to Caṇḍikā;
protect, protect me, O Supreme Goddess! || 5 ||
When pleased, you dispel all diseases without exception; when angered, however, [you take away] all desired objects.
For those who have taken refuge in you, there is no misfortune; indeed, those who have taken refuge in you attain the state of being worthy of refuge.
Oṃ, salutations to Caṇḍikā; salutations to Caṇḍikā; salutations to Caṇḍikā!
Oṃ, salutations to Caṇḍikā; salutations to Caṇḍikā; salutations to Caṇḍikā!
Be gracious to me, O Supreme Goddess. || 7 ||
O Śrī Durgā, who has eighteen arms and rides upon a lion;
O Goddess, bestower of auspiciousness, protect us from all fears—salutations be unto you! || 8 ||
Bibhīṣaṇa said: "I am a sinner, I am one of evil deeds, I am evil-souled, and I am born of evil.
Save me, O Primordial Mother; become the remover of all sins. (9)
